_about: JPS Selangor pond list (Kolam_Fasa_JPS, phases 1-4), from the public ArcGIS layer jpsselgis.selangor.gov.my/gis/rest/services/AppHydro/Kolam_Fasa_JPS (layers kolam_fasa_1..4), read 22 Oct 2026. Kept: pond code, phase, district, town, address, listed area (acres), survey date, outline. Dropped on purpose: the names of the staff who surveyed, prepared and checked each entry, and land-title and lot numbers. Being on the list is evidence that JPS lists the pond; it does not say who maintains it (research/RESPONSIBILITY_RECORD.md).
